description: A project tracker built entirely from stock Svelte 5 data grid props. Nested collapsible column groups for Task, Details, Timeline and Progress keep a primary column visible and tag the rest with columnGroupShow 'open'; showRowNumbers with rowDragManaged turns the number column into a drag grip for reordering; Status, Priority and Assignee are editorType list dropdowns and the dates editorType date; a cell snippet renders the progress bar from the editable Progress number; and showPagination pages ten rows at a time with pageSizeOptions.

faq.question: How do I get row drag without writing drag code?
faq.answer: Set rowDragManaged together with showRowNumbers. The number column becomes the grip, and the grid splices its own data on drop.

faq.question: How are the column groups collapsed?
faq.answer: Each group definition lists its child columns; the ones tagged columnGroupShow: 'open' hide when the group's header caret is closed, and openByDefault sets the initial state.

faq.question: Does editing Progress update the bar?
faq.answer: Yes. The bar is a cell snippet reading the row's progress value; committing a new number re-renders it at the new width.
